title: Greedy reach — Jump Game I and II
summary: Track the farthest index reachable so far; for minimum jumps, treat each jump as a BFS level whose range is [current end + 1, farthest].

sections.title: Can you reach the end?
Minimum number of jumps
Complexity
sections.body: Both O(n) time, O(1) space. A DP solution (min jumps to reach each index) is O(n²) — the greedy is the expected answer.
